name: Corum Ranked
description: A separate server-authoritative Corum Ranked client. It does not share runtime state or UI with Corum Integration.

ranked-server-url.name: Ranked server URL
ranked-server-url.description: Base URL of the Corum Ranked server. HTTPS is required except for localhost development. This is not a secret.

poll-interval-ms.name: Polling interval (ms)
poll-interval-ms.description: REST short-poll interval. The server remains authoritative for clocks and deadlines.
